challenge.title: Every Learning Gap Deserves Attention.
challenge.desc: In primary education, early foundational hurdles in numeracy and literacy quickly compound when left unaddressed. StudySaathi AI helps teachers uncover subtle misconceptions before they become permanent roadblocks.
challenge.c1Text: A small misunderstanding of place value in Grade 3 often turns into intense fraction anxiety by Grade 5. Identifying the root issue early restores student confidence.
challenge.c2Text: Primary school teachers manage 40+ diverse students with varied learning speeds. Manually diagnosing each child's specific hurdle across every topic is overwhelming without automated support.
challenge.c3Text: Instead of repeating entire chapters or assigning generic homework, teachers can deploy 10-minute micro-interventions targeted specifically at the student's exact missing concept.

howItWorks.title: From Diagnosis to Mastery in 5 Steps
howItWorks.desc: A structured, teacher-centered loop designed specifically for foundational learning frameworks (FLN & NIPUN Bharat).
howItWorks.s1Text: Administer brief 5-question periodic checks or regular class assessments across Indian classroom languages.
howItWorks.s2Text: The AI model classifies student answers, distinguishing between casual calculation slips and deep conceptual misunderstandings.
howItWorks.s3Text: Transparent, explainable diagnostic notes outline the exact prerequisite skill the learner is missing (e.g., regrouping across zeros).
howItWorks.s4Text: Generate printable multilingual practice sheets, scaffolded exercises, and concrete activity prompts for classroom or home practice.
howItWorks.s5Text: Conduct quick 3-minute check-ins to verify mastery, updating individual and class progress trajectories toward 100% competency.

features.title: Designed for Real Classrooms
features.desc: Verified tools built for Indian school environments — functioning with zero cloud latency and broad Indian language support.
features.f1Text: Instant diagnosis of student answer patterns down to sub-competency levels, flagging root causes without teacher guesswork.
features.f2Text: Continuous longitudinal tracking from baseline diagnostic score to full mastery, with early intervention alerts.
features.f3Text: Clear, plain-language diagnostic rationales explaining exactly why a student struggled, keeping teachers firmly in control.
features.f4Text: Dynamic multi-week roadmaps tailored to individual learners or small cohorts with shared conceptual hurdles.
features.f5Text: One-click printable PDF generation of targeted practice sheets complete with teacher answer keys and step-by-step scaffolds.
features.f6Text: Dynamic script switching and vernacular support across Indian classroom languages, diagnostic explanations, and parent notices.

teachers.title: Your AI Co-Pilot in the Classroom
teachers.desc: StudySaathi AI saves teachers up to 6 hours each week by automating diagnostic grading, grouping students with similar hurdles, and drafting targeted remedial material.
teachers.b1Text: Instantly clusters 40 students into 3-4 targeted learning groups for small-group instruction.
teachers.b2Text: Ready-to-print worksheets with foundational scaffolds aligned to FLN competencies.
teachers.b3Text: Know exactly which 5 students need 10 minutes of extra support on regrouping before moving to division.
